No sunshine and no leaf shadows anywhere inside: the classroom is lit evenly by the cool grey daylight and by the ceiling fluorescent tubes, which are switched on. The walls keep the same plain soft yellow paint and darker dado (no murals). The cassette recorder, the microphone and the children's drawings of 1995 are gone; the teacher's table holds only a neat stack of exercise books and a pencil box.

On the window sill a row of small potted plants.

The classroom door stays the box labelled 'exit: Školská chodba v roku 1982' in image 2 (x 337-505, y 376-720 of the 1920x1080 frame (18-26 % from the left, 35-67 % from the top)).

Fiction rules: the period details are invented scenery: no portraits, no flags, no emblems, no slogans, no logos, no brand names, no readable text (cards and headlines are illegible scribbles or pseudo-letters, no digits). No people, no animals.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except what is asked for above, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
